'''Racing Club de Lens''' ({{IPA|fr|ʁasiŋ klœb də lɑ̃s}}), commonly referred to as '''RC Lens''' or simply as '''Lens''', is a [[football in France|French professional football]] club based in the northern city of [[Lens, Pas-de-Calais|Lens]] in the [[Departments of France|department]] of [[Pas-de-Calais]]. The club's nickname, ''Les Sang et Or'' ({{Translation|The Blood and Gold}}), comes from its traditional colours of red and gold. As of the 2026–27 season, Lens competes in Ligue 1, the highest tier of French football.

Lens won the [[Ligue 1|Division 1]] (now Ligue 1) title in the [[1997–98 French Division 1|1997–98 season]], and has finished as runner-up on five occasions, most recently in the [[2025–26 Ligue 1|2025–26]] season. Lens also finished as runner-up three times in [[Coupe de France]] before securing their maiden cup in [[2025–26 Coupe de France|2026]].  Lens won the [[Trophée des Champions]] for the first time in [[2026 Trophée des Champions|2026]], having finished as runner-up in [[1998 Trophée des Champions|1998]]. The club has a strong rivalry with neighbors [[Lille OSC]], with whom they contest the ''[[Derby du Nord]]''."}}
